tools.name: talk_to
tools.description: Talk to someone (within 50m). Others nearby will overhear. Fails if target is working/sleeping.

tools.name: eat_food
tools.description: Eat a food item from inventory or buy immediately.

tools.name: buy_item
tools.description: Buy an item to your inventory, or purchase a property/house to move in.

tools.name: work_job
tools.description: Work to earn money. Initiates a 3-step interactive scenario. Follow the backend prompts to use pick_item and interact_with.

tools.name: get_education
tools.description: Study to boost wage. Initiates a 3-step interactive exam. Follow the backend prompts.

tools.name: move_to
tools.description: Travel to a location. Drains Energy based on distance.

tools.name: call_person
tools.description: Call someone by phone. Fails if target is working/sleeping.

tools.name: interact_with
tools.description: Interact with person, object, or answer a Test (e.g., action='A').

tools.name: change_status
tools.description: Change relationship status or personal beliefs (e.g. your long term goals).

tools.name: attack_person
tools.description: Attack another person within 20m. Fails if target is working/sleeping.

tools.name: buy_stock
tools.description: Buy shares of the village stock.

tools.name: sell_stock
tools.description: Sell shares of the village stock.

tools.name: sleep
tools.description: Sleep to restore energy. During this time, you cannot be interacted with.

tools.name: do_hobby
tools.description: Use an item (like a Book or Art Supplies) to reduce stress.

tools.name: give_item
tools.description: Give an item from your inventory to someone within 20m. Fails if target is working/sleeping.

tools.name: give_money
tools.description: Transfer funds to someone within 20m. Fails if target is working/sleeping.

tools.name: pick_item
tools.description: Move an item from inventory to your hands. To put an item away, use item_name='None' or 'store'.
